d:
Shadi ke bad pati-patni ke bich pyar aur romans ka izhar kya samaj ki tay maryadaon ke dayre men hi hona chahie? rahul gandhi ne jab apne mata-pita ke rishte se jura ek niji kissa sajha kiya, to soshal midiya par bahas chhir gaee.
Lekin is bahas ke bahane ek bara saval samne aaya hai. bhartiy samaj men shadi ke bad pati-patni ke bich prem, sharirik nazdiki aur antrangta ko kis nazar se dekha jata hai? kya shadi ke bad rishta sirph parivar aur bachchon ki zimmedariyon tak simat jata hai? aur kya aaj ki pirhi is soch ko badal rahi hai?
